name: worldwright
description: LILITH's Claude Code plugin: the suite's MCP server lil, the hooks that ask before deletes, installs and script runs, and the skills carried from plugin 1.2.0.

lil_mcp_path.title: lil-mcp.exe
lil_mcp_path.description: The suite's MCP server. Normally %LOCALAPPDATA%\LILITH\bin\lil-mcp.exe; for a dev build, lil-mcp.exe in its build folder. lil doctor names the path for your channel.

lil_path.title: lil.exe
lil_path.description: The suite's command line, which runs the plugin's hooks. Normally %LOCALAPPDATA%\LILITH\bin\lil.exe, beside lil-mcp.exe; for a dev build, lil.exe in its build folder. lil doctor names the path for your channel.
